color.$description: SEMANTIC color tokens — DARK mode (Lumen v0.11 default — Obsidian Mint). Mirrors color.light.tokens.json key paths with the obsidian-mint ramp + spring-green accent. Glass + glow utilities are exposed as separate semantic keys for clarity.

raised.$description: Raised surface #1B1E1C — sits subtly above canvas with restrained mint tilt. v0.11.11 retune from #21241F (darker + tilt scaled to G+3) so panels read as a card on canvas, not a brighter surface.

popover.$description: Floating popover surface #232624. v0.11.11 retune from #2E3230 — darker, mint tilt restrained to match the rest of the ramp.

glass.$description: Floating glass shell — pair with backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(140%). v0.11.13 — references the canvas-anchored alpha primitive (was inlined as rgba(23,26,24,0.62)).

overlay.$description: Translucent backdrop for sticky chrome. v0.11.13 — references {color.alpha.ink.86}.

scrim.$description: Modal scrim. v0.11.13 — references {color.alpha.void.72} (anchored to brand.950 #060807) so the scrim reads ~18% darker than canvas-anchored alpha and the floating modal is unmistakably above a darker plate.

tint-accent.$description: Spring-green tint for hover / selection backgrounds.

input.$description: v0.6 — input field surfaces. Aliased so theming can shift inputs without disturbing card chrome.

rest.$description: Same as surface.raised; named role for input bg.

readOnly.$description: Read-only keeps full contrast — same bg as rest. Caret hidden, content selectable.

disabled.$description: Sunken bg signals 'not interactive'. Paired with disabled border + text.

primary.$description: Body and titles — #E6E6E6, the user-fixed brand light value. Contrast 13.7:1 on canvas — AAA. Not pure white (which would feel harsh on obsidian-mint).

tertiary.$description: Hints, eyebrow labels. ~3.6:1 — AA Large only (≥18px).

placeholder.$description: Input placeholder. Alias of tertiary; carries its own role for theming.

accent.$description: Laser spring-green for inline emphasis on dark. ~10.4:1 — AAA.

error.$description: v0.11 — softened error text on canvas. ~6.5:1 — AA Normal. Distinct from status.danger.fg which is the badge text on a danger background. v0.11.13 — references the new {color.status.danger.300} primitive (was inlined #F8A8AA).

success.$description: v0.6 — success text. Reuses accent ramp; spring green is action/live/success.

warning.$description: v0.11 — warning text. ~9.1:1 — AAA on canvas. v0.11.13 — references the new {color.status.warning.300} primitive (was inlined #F5DEA3).

hairline.$description: Default hairline at 6% white — the breathing-room separator (per principles §1, §3).

frame.$description: v0.4 — brutalist hairline frame border, hairline-strong

error.$description: v0.6 — input error border. Refined red for the hairline stroke.

success.$description: v0.6 — input success border. Spring green; only after explicit validation.

warning.$description: v0.6 — input warning border. Refined amber.

disabled.$description: v0.6 — input disabled border. Muted; no hover/focus.

fg.$description: Near-black-mint #07120D on spring green — 14.7:1 AAA. Never inherit text-primary.

tertiary.$description: v0.9 alias of ghost — kept for backwards compatibility. New code uses ghost surface composed with neutral intent. v0.11.13 — hover/press references {color.alpha.paper.06}.

ghost.$description: v0.9 — no chrome at rest, subtle hover tint. The neutral × ghost surface.

outline.$description: v0.9 — hairline pill (transparent fill, 1px border). The neutral × outline surface.

danger.$description: v0.11 — danger CTA on dark. bg deepened red.500→.700 to clear WCAG AA Normal.

fg.$description: 5.4:1 on danger.700 — passes AA Normal. v0.11.13 — references the new {color.absolute.white} primitive (was inlined #FFFFFF).

danger-soft.$description: v0.9 — danger × ghost surface. For destructive actions in tight contexts (table row delete, settings) where solid red would over-emphasize. v0.11.13 — bg.hover/press reference {color.alpha.danger.12}/{18}; fg references {color.status.danger.300}.

fg.$description: Lumen text.error — 6.5:1 on canvas. v0.11.13 — references the new status.danger.300 primitive.

ai.$description: v0.9 — AI-action variant. Spring-green tonal surface + sparkle leading icon. Sparingly: only on AI-driven primary actions (Improve, Summarize, Suggest, Quote-with-AI). Not a general-purpose intent. See ADR 0016.

fg.$description: Laser spring-green — brighter than accent.fg on tonal surface to maintain perceived hierarchy.

success.$description: v0.9 — success-affirmation feedback variant. Same spring-green palette as primary per the single-accent rule, but tonal not solid. Used briefly (1.6 s) post-success state of any button.

selected.$description: v0.9 — aria-pressed=true state for ToggleButton / Segmented option. Subtle spring-green tint + spring-green hairline. Distinct from primary (filled green).

glass.$description: v0.9 — translucent surface for floating overlays. Composes with backdrop-filter: blur(12px). Not a default primary. v0.11.13 — hover/press migrated from inline rgba(23,26,24,X) to {color.alpha.ink.72}/{86} so a future canvas retune cascades.

neutral.$description: v0.11.15 — neutral status pill bg + fg. Pre-v0.11.15 the bg ran through {color.brand.700} (raised), which collided with --surface-raised on Card-mounted badges and made the pill visually disappear. Re-anchored to a paper-alpha overlay so the chip reads as a slight lift on every dark surface (canvas, raised, popover, sunken).

bg.$description: Translucent overlay so the pill reads on any surface; the paper-alpha sits cooler against the obsidian-mint canvas without competing with the spring-green accent.

fg.$description: User-fixed brand light #E6E6E6 — 13.4:1 on raised surface (AAA).

aurora.$description: Radial spring-green ambient glow — the brand's signature lighting gesture. Render as a fixed/absolute pseudo-element behind the page hero with backdrop-filter: blur and the values below. v0.11 keeps the v0.4 recipe verbatim — same opacity, new hue.
